easy: A fighter in a small, unofficial army that attacks a stronger army by surprise.

ex.en: The guerrillas hid in the jungle and moved only at night.
ex.ko: 게릴라 대원들은 정글에 숨어 밤에만 움직였다.

easy: A member of a group of horse riders who came from Asia and invaded Europe long ago.

ex.en: The Huns rode their horses all the way from Asia into Europe.
ex.ko: 훈족은 말을 타고 아시아에서 유럽까지 달려왔다.

easy: When a powerful country takes control of other countries to make its empire bigger.

ex.en: In history class, we learned how imperialism changed Africa and Asia.
ex.ko: 역사 시간에 우리는 제국주의가 아프리카와 아시아를 어떻게 바꾸었는지 배웠다.

easy: To teach an idea or feeling by saying it again and again until it sticks.

ex.en: Our coach infused us with the idea of never giving up.
ex.ko: 코치님은 우리에게 절대 포기하지 말라는 생각을 불어넣어 주셨다.

easy: A person who owns land.

ex.en: The landowner let us camp in his field by the river.
ex.ko: 땅 주인은 우리가 강가 들판에서 캠핑하게 해 주었다.

easy: A light cotton cloth, often with a bright plaid pattern.

ex.en: Dad's summer shirt is made of plaid madras.
ex.ko: 아빠의 여름 셔츠는 체크무늬 마드라스 천으로 만들어졌다.

easy: A system that lets electronic music keyboards and computers talk to each other.

ex.en: The keyboard connects to the computer using MIDI.
ex.ko: 그 키보드는 미디로 컴퓨터에 연결된다.

easy: A small crime that is less serious than a big one.

ex.en: Littering is a misdemeanor in our town.
ex.ko: 우리 마을에서는 쓰레기를 함부로 버리는 것이 경범죄이다.

easy: A punishment that someone deserves for doing something bad.

ex.en: The villain got his retribution at the end of the story.
ex.ko: 이야기 끝에서 악당은 마땅한 벌을 받았다.

easy: Having to do with using words in a clever way to make people think or feel something.

ex.en: "Who wants ice cream?" was a rhetorical question, because of course we all did.
ex.ko: "아이스크림 먹을 사람?"은 대답이 필요 없는 질문이었다. 당연히 우리 모두 원했으니까.

easy: To cover something with a wet, sticky liquid.

ex.en: The snail slimed the window as it crawled.
ex.ko: 달팽이가 기어가면서 창문에 끈적한 점액을 묻혔다.

easy: A long, serious piece of writing about one subject.

ex.en: The scientist wrote a long treatise on honeybees.
ex.ko: 그 과학자는 꿀벌에 대한 긴 논문을 썼다.

easy: A family of emperors who ruled China for a very long time, about 3,000 years ago.

ex.en: Confucius lived during the Zhou dynasty.
ex.ko: 공자는 주나라 시대에 살았다.

easy: A serious illness that slowly makes a person's muscles weak.

ex.en: The ice bucket challenge raised money to fight ALS.
ex.ko: 아이스 버킷 챌린지는 루게릭병과 싸우기 위한 돈을 모았다.

easy: Written records of what a group has done, year by year.

ex.en: The club's annals record every game it has ever played.
ex.ko: 그 동호회의 연보에는 지금까지 치른 모든 경기가 기록되어 있다.

easy: Made to stop one company from unfairly controlling all the buying and selling of something.

ex.en: Antitrust laws stop one company from owning a whole market.
ex.ko: 독점 금지법은 한 회사가 시장 전체를 차지하지 못하게 막는다.

easy: A lawyer in Britain or Canada who speaks for people in the higher courts.

ex.en: The barrister wore a white wig in the British court.
ex.ko: 영국 법정에서 법정 변호사는 하얀 가발을 썼다.

easy: Supported by both of the two main political parties.

ex.en: The new park law had bipartisan support.
ex.ko: 새 공원법은 두 정당 모두의 지지를 받았다.

easy: A company that helps people buy and sell stocks for a fee.

ex.en: My uncle works at a brokerage in the city.
ex.ko: 삼촌은 시내에 있는 증권 회사에서 일한다.

easy: A navy officer who ranks above a captain.

ex.en: The commodore commanded a group of ships.
ex.ko: 해군 준장이 함대를 지휘했다.

easy: A person who collects information and puts it together, like in a book.

ex.en: The compiler of the dictionary spent years collecting words.
ex.ko: 그 사전의 편찬자는 몇 년 동안 단어를 모았다.

easy: A number used in India that means ten million.

ex.en: The movie earned one hundred crore rupees in India.
ex.ko: 그 영화는 인도에서 10억 루피를 벌었다.

easy: The time when people must be home or off the streets.

ex.en: My curfew is eight o'clock on school nights.
ex.ko: 학교 가는 날 밤에 내 귀가 시간은 8시이다.

easy: When something goes down in price or value.

ex.en: A new car has quick depreciation once you drive it away.
ex.ko: 새 차는 몰고 나가는 순간 가치가 빨리 떨어진다.

easy: A chemical in the brain that helps you move and feel rewarded.

ex.en: Dopamine is a brain chemical that helps you feel good when you do well.
ex.ko: 도파민은 무언가를 잘 해냈을 때 기분 좋게 해 주는 뇌 속 화학 물질이다.

easy: Choosing the best things from many different styles or ideas.

ex.en: Grandma has an eclectic collection of teapots from all over the world.
ex.ko: 할머니는 세계 곳곳에서 모은 갖가지 찻주전자를 가지고 계신다.

easy: To force someone to leave a place.

ex.en: The referee ejected the player for pushing.
ex.ko: 심판은 상대를 민 선수를 퇴장시켰다.

easy: To make something necessary as a result.

ex.en: Getting a puppy entails walking it every day.
ex.ko: 강아지를 키우려면 매일 산책을 시켜야 한다.

easy: The seventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

ex.en: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet.
ex.ko: 에타는 그리스 문자의 일곱 번째 글자이다.

easy: The family of kings and queens who ruled Britain from 1714 to 1901.

ex.en: Queen Victoria was the last ruler from the House of Hanover.
ex.ko: 빅토리아 여왕은 하노버 왕가의 마지막 통치자였다.

easy: A person who fights against the government with weapons.

ex.en: The insurgents fought against the government's army.
ex.ko: 반란군은 정부군에 맞서 싸웠다.

easy: The first time a company sells pieces of itself, called shares, to the public.

ex.en: After its IPO, anyone could buy shares of the company.
ex.ko: 기업 공개 뒤에는 누구나 그 회사의 주식을 살 수 있었다.

easy: A person who pretends to be your friend and then betrays you.

ex.en: He called his old friend a Judas for telling his secret.
ex.ko: 그는 자기 비밀을 말해 버린 옛 친구를 배신자라고 불렀다.

easy: A device that shoots rockets into the air.

ex.en: The launcher shot the toy rocket high into the sky.
ex.ko: 발사기가 장난감 로켓을 하늘 높이 쏘아 올렸다.

easy: Being allowed by the law.

ex.en: The judge checked the legality of the new rule.
ex.ko: 판사는 새 규칙이 합법적인지 살펴보았다.

easy: The qualities that people think of as typical of men or boys.

ex.en: Crying does not take away a boy's masculinity.
ex.ko: 운다고 해서 남자아이의 남자다움이 사라지지는 않는다.

easy: A very strong medicine made from poppies, used to stop terrible pain.

ex.en: The doctor gave the injured man morphine for the pain.
ex.ko: 의사는 다친 남자에게 통증을 줄이려고 모르핀을 주었다.

easy: Being a mother.

ex.en: My aunt says motherhood is hard but full of joy.
ex.ko: 이모는 엄마가 되는 것이 힘들지만 기쁨이 가득하다고 말한다.

easy: A short note meaning "pay special attention to this."

ex.en: NB: Bring your swimsuit on Friday.
ex.ko: 참고: 금요일에 수영복을 가져오세요.

easy: Having to do with the hip bones.

ex.en: Your pelvic bones hold up the top half of your body.
ex.ko: 골반뼈는 몸의 윗부분을 받쳐 준다.

easy: Playing drums and other instruments that you hit or shake.

ex.en: Jake plays percussion in the school band.
ex.ko: 제이크는 학교 밴드에서 타악기를 연주한다.

easy: A person who says ordinary people's needs matter more than the rich and powerful.

ex.en: The populist promised to help farmers and factory workers.
ex.ko: 그 포퓰리스트는 농부와 공장 노동자들을 돕겠다고 약속했다.

easy: Helping to guess what will happen next.

ex.en: My phone has predictive text that guesses my next word.
ex.ko: 내 휴대폰에는 다음 단어를 짐작해 주는 자동 완성 기능이 있다.

easy: Having to do with race, the groups people belong to by where their families came from.

ex.en: Our school is racially diverse, with kids from many backgrounds.
ex.ko: 우리 학교는 여러 배경을 가진 아이들이 있어서 인종적으로 다양하다.

easy: Filling something completely with a liquid or other substance.

ex.en: The saturation of the sponge with water made it heavy.
ex.ko: 물을 흠뻑 머금은 스펀지는 무거워졌다.

easy: Something bad that happens and slows down your progress.

ex.en: Breaking my arm was a big setback for my soccer season.
ex.ko: 팔이 부러진 것은 내 축구 시즌에 큰 차질이었다.

easy: A soft, comfy shoe you wear inside the house.

ex.en: I put on my fuzzy slippers when I got home.
ex.ko: 나는 집에 오자마자 폭신한 실내화를 신었다.

easy: Selling things to make money.

ex.en: Vending lemonade on the corner earned us ten dollars.
ex.ko: 길모퉁이에서 레모네이드를 팔아서 우리는 10달러를 벌었다.

easy: A person who believes people should live without any government.

ex.en: The anarchist said that nobody should be in charge.
ex.ko: 그 무정부주의자는 아무도 다스려서는 안 된다고 말했다.

easy: A short, interesting story about something that really happened.

ex.en: Grandpa told a funny anecdote about his first car.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 첫 차에 얽힌 재미있는 일화를 들려주셨다.

easy: Having to do with the Church of England and churches like it.

ex.en: An Anglican bishop led the service at the old cathedral.
ex.ko: 오래된 대성당에서 성공회 주교가 예배를 이끌었다.

easy: A member of the Church of England or a church like it.

ex.en: My British pen pal's family are Anglicans.
ex.ko: 내 영국 펜팔 친구 가족은 성공회 신자이다.

easy: The science of the chemicals and chemical changes inside living things.

ex.en: In biochemistry, scientists study how our bodies turn food into energy.
ex.ko: 생화학에서 과학자들은 우리 몸이 음식을 어떻게 에너지로 바꾸는지 연구한다.

easy: A fast, exciting kind of jazz that started around 1940.

ex.en: Grandpa loves listening to old bop records.
ex.ko: 할아버지는 오래된 비밥 음반 듣는 것을 아주 좋아하신다.

easy: A seed case covered with tiny hooks that stick to fur and clothes.

ex.en: My dog came home with burrs stuck in his fur.
ex.ko: 우리 개가 털에 가시 열매를 잔뜩 붙이고 집에 왔다.

easy: Not caring about other people's feelings or things, in a proud way.

ex.en: He had a cavalier attitude about breaking other kids' toys.
ex.ko: 그는 다른 아이들의 장난감을 망가뜨려도 아무렇지 않게 굴었다.

easy: When people from one country go to settle in and take control of another land.

ex.en: We read about the British colonization of America.
ex.ko: 우리는 영국의 아메리카 식민지화에 대해 읽었다.

easy: Growing or found in many parts of the world.

ex.en: Dandelions are a cosmopolitan plant found almost everywhere.
ex.ko: 민들레는 거의 어디에서나 볼 수 있는, 전 세계에 퍼진 식물이다.

easy: A person who has traveled a lot and feels at home in many countries.

ex.en: My aunt is a cosmopolitan who has lived in five countries.
ex.ko: 이모는 다섯 나라에서 살아 본 세계인이다.

easy: Not working the way it should.

ex.en: The old printer is dysfunctional and jams every time.
ex.ko: 낡은 프린터는 제대로 작동하지 않아서 매번 종이가 걸린다.

easy: A hormone that helps a girl's body grow into a woman's body.

ex.en: Estrogen is a hormone that is important for women's bodies.
ex.ko: 에스트로겐은 여성의 몸에 중요한 호르몬이다.

easy: Having to do with the old system where lords owned land and farmers worked on it.

ex.en: In feudal times, farmers worked the land for a lord.
ex.ko: 봉건 시대에는 농민들이 영주를 위해 땅을 일구었다.

easy: To make something flat.

ex.en: I flattened the clay with a rolling pin.
ex.ko: 나는 밀대로 찰흙을 납작하게 폈다.

easy: A kind of tough black cattle from Scotland.

ex.en: Galloway cattle have thick, shaggy black coats.
ex.ko: 갤러웨이 소는 두껍고 덥수룩한 검은 털을 가지고 있다.

easy: A person, especially in the 1960s, who rejected normal ways of living and liked peace and flowers.

ex.en: My grandma was a hippie who wore flowers in her hair.
ex.ko: 우리 할머니는 머리에 꽃을 꽂고 다니던 히피였다.

easy: A member of a people who live in the mountains where Turkey, Iraq, Iran, and Syria meet.

ex.en: Many Kurds live in the mountains of Turkey, Iraq, and Iran.
ex.ko: 많은 쿠르드인이 터키, 이라크, 이란의 산악 지대에 산다.

easy: A pattern of points or pieces that repeat in neat rows.

ex.en: Salt crystals form a lattice of tiny cubes.
ex.ko: 소금 결정은 작은 정육면체들이 줄지어 있는 격자 모양을 이룬다.

easy: In a fair way that follows the rules.

ex.en: You can only legitimately win if you follow the rules.
ex.ko: 규칙을 지켜야만 정당하게 이길 수 있다.

easy: Living in or using a place for a time.

ex.en: During their occupancy of the apartment, they kept it very clean.
ex.ko: 그 아파트에 사는 동안 그들은 집을 아주 깨끗하게 썼다.

easy: The part of medicine that studies and treats cancer and tumors.

ex.en: The children's hospital has a big oncology ward.
ex.ko: 그 어린이 병원에는 큰 종양 병동이 있다.

easy: To pay another company to do some of your work.

ex.en: The company outsources its cleaning to another business.
ex.ko: 그 회사는 청소 일을 다른 업체에 맡긴다.

easy: Having to do with the study of diseases.

ex.en: The doctor sent the samples to a pathological lab.
ex.ko: 의사는 검사물을 병리 검사실로 보냈다.

easy: Making fun of people's silly or bad actions to show what is wrong.

ex.en: The satirical cartoon made fun of the mayor's giant hat.
ex.ko: 그 풍자 만화는 시장의 커다란 모자를 놀렸다.

easy: A person from Spain.

ex.en: The Spaniard taught us how to dance the flamenco.
ex.ko: 그 스페인 사람은 우리에게 플라멩코 추는 법을 가르쳐 주었다.

easy: Saying something in a much smaller or weaker way than it really is.

ex.en: Calling the hurricane "a little windy" was an understatement.
ex.ko: 허리케인을 "바람이 좀 분다"고 한 것은 너무 약하게 말한 것이었다.

easy: Not wanted.

ex.en: Weeds are undesirable plants in a vegetable garden.
ex.ko: 잡초는 채소밭에서 원치 않는 식물이다.

easy: Weapons all together.

ex.en: The castle museum showed old weaponry like swords and shields.
ex.ko: 성 박물관에는 칼과 방패 같은 옛 무기들이 전시되어 있었다.

easy: Money paid to someone in regular amounts, like every month, for many years.

ex.en: Grandma gets an annuity check every month.
ex.ko: 할머니는 매달 연금 수표를 받으신다.

easy: A huge piece of ice floating in the sea; an iceberg.

ex.en: The ship sailed carefully around the huge berg.
ex.ko: 배는 거대한 빙산을 조심스럽게 돌아서 지나갔다.

easy: To surround a place with an army so the people inside have to give up.

ex.en: The army besieged the castle for six months.
ex.ko: 군대는 여섯 달 동안 성을 포위했다.

easy: The meat of a fish with whiskers, often fried in the southern United States.

ex.en: We had fried catfish for dinner in Louisiana.
ex.ko: 우리는 루이지애나에서 저녁으로 메기 튀김을 먹었다.

easy: A soldier who went on the Crusades, long wars fought over the Holy Land in the Middle Ages.

ex.en: The Crusaders traveled thousands of miles from Europe.
ex.ko: 십자군은 유럽에서 수천 마일을 이동했다.

easy: To force someone to leave the place where they live.

ex.en: The landlord wanted to evict the noisy tenants.
ex.ko: 집주인은 시끄러운 세입자들을 내보내고 싶어 했다.

easy: Coming from Haiti, a country in the Caribbean Sea, or its people.

ex.en: We ate Haitian rice and beans at the food festival.
ex.ko: 우리는 음식 축제에서 아이티식 콩밥을 먹었다.

easy: A person from Haiti.

ex.en: My classmate is a Haitian who speaks French and Creole.
ex.ko: 우리 반 친구는 프랑스어와 크리올어를 하는 아이티 사람이다.

easy: An idea that goes against what a church or group officially believes.

ex.en: Long ago, saying that Earth goes around the Sun was called heresy.
ex.ko: 오래전에는 지구가 태양 주위를 돈다는 말이 이단으로 여겨졌다.

easy: The US government department that helps people find safe, affordable homes.

ex.en: HUD helps families find safe homes they can afford.
ex.ko: 미국 주택 도시 개발부는 가족들이 감당할 수 있는 안전한 집을 찾도록 돕는다.

easy: A court of the Catholic Church long ago that punished people for having different beliefs.

ex.en: Galileo was put on trial by the Inquisition.
ex.ko: 갈릴레오는 종교 재판에 넘겨졌다.

easy: The ideas of Karl Marx about money, work, and how society should be run.

ex.en: Marxism says workers should own the factories.
ex.ko: 마르크스주의는 노동자가 공장을 소유해야 한다고 말한다.

easy: Something built of stone or brick.

ex.en: The old masonry of the castle wall was cracked.
ex.ko: 성벽의 오래된 돌 구조물에 금이 가 있었다.

easy: A dark Asian bird that can copy sounds and even human words.

ex.en: The mina in the pet store said "hello" to us.
ex.ko: 애완동물 가게의 구관조가 우리에게 "안녕"이라고 말했다.

easy: The US government agency that does medical research to keep people healthy.

ex.en: Scientists at the NIH study how to cure diseases.
ex.ko: 미국 국립 보건원의 과학자들은 병을 고치는 방법을 연구한다.

easy: To be more in number than another group.

ex.en: In our class, girls outnumber boys twelve to ten.
ex.ko: 우리 반은 여자아이가 열두 명, 남자아이가 열 명으로 여자아이가 더 많다.

easy: In a way that has to do with the mind and feelings.

ex.en: Moving to a new school can be psychologically hard.
ex.ko: 새 학교로 전학 가는 것은 심리적으로 힘들 수 있다.

easy: To put someone back in their old job or position.

ex.en: After the mistake was found, the coach reinstated him as captain.
ex.ko: 잘못이 밝혀지자 코치는 그를 다시 주장으로 복귀시켰다.

easy: Able to be taxed; you must pay tax on it.

ex.en: Toys are taxable in our state, but most food is not.
ex.ko: 우리 주에서 장난감에는 세금이 붙지만 대부분의 식품에는 붙지 않는다.

easy: Done by only one side or one person, without the others agreeing.

ex.en: Mom made a unilateral decision: no screens on school nights.
ex.ko: 엄마는 학교 가는 날 밤에는 화면을 보지 않기로 혼자 정하셨다.

easy: In Chinese thought, the dark, quiet side of the world that balances yang.

ex.en: Yin and yang are two opposite forces that balance each other.
ex.ko: 음과 양은 서로 균형을 이루는 두 반대 힘이다.

easy: To end a meeting or court session for a while.

ex.en: The meeting adjourned at five o'clock.
ex.ko: 회의는 5시에 휴회했다.

easy: To make something bigger, louder, or stronger.

ex.en: The microphone amplified the singer's voice.
ex.ko: 마이크가 가수의 목소리를 크게 키웠다.

easy: Having to do with a court that looks at a case again when someone asks.

ex.en: The case went to an appellate court.
ex.ko: 그 사건은 항소 법원으로 넘어갔다.

easy: Checking and fixing a measuring tool so it shows the right numbers.

ex.en: The bathroom scale needed calibration because it showed the wrong weight.
ex.ko: 욕실 저울이 몸무게를 틀리게 보여 줘서 눈금을 맞춰야 했다.

easy: An old Celtic language from Cornwall, in the southwest of England.

ex.en: A few people are learning to speak Cornish again.
ex.ko: 몇몇 사람들이 콘월어를 다시 배우고 있다.

easy: Having to do with Cornwall, a part of southwest England, or its people.

ex.en: We ate a Cornish pasty, a pie full of meat and potatoes.
ex.ko: 우리는 고기와 감자가 가득 든 파이인 콘월식 패스티를 먹었다.

easy: A very small amount of something.

ex.en: He gave us only a crumb of information about the surprise.
ex.ko: 그는 깜짝 선물에 대해 아주 조금만 알려 주었다.

easy: To cover food with bread crumbs.

ex.en: Mom crumbed the chicken before frying it.
ex.ko: 엄마는 닭고기를 튀기기 전에 빵가루를 묻히셨다.

easy: A US government agency that gathers secret information about other countries' armies.

ex.en: The DIA gathers information about other countries' armies.
ex.ko: 미국 국방 정보국은 다른 나라 군대에 대한 정보를 모은다.

easy: Causing people to disagree and split into groups.

ex.en: The divisive vote split our class into two angry groups.
ex.ko: 그 투표 때문에 우리 반은 화난 두 편으로 갈라졌다.

easy: The US government department in charge of the army, navy, and air force.

ex.en: The Department of Defense is in a building called the Pentagon.
ex.ko: 미국 국방부는 펜타곤이라는 건물에 있다.

easy: To be a perfect example of an idea or quality.

ex.en: Our team captain embodies kindness and hard work.
ex.ko: 우리 팀 주장은 친절함과 성실함 그 자체이다.

easy: To sew colorful designs onto cloth.

ex.en: Grandma embroidered flowers on my pillowcase.
ex.ko: 할머니는 내 베갯잇에 꽃을 수놓아 주셨다.

easy: To happen as a result.

ex.en: When the dog ran into the kitchen, chaos ensued.
ex.ko: 개가 부엌으로 뛰어들자 난장판이 벌어졌다.

easy: To be very angry and show it.

ex.en: My brother fumed when I beat him at chess.
ex.ko: 내가 체스에서 이기자 형은 씩씩거리며 화를 냈다.

easy: Smoke or gas that smells bad or is harmful.

ex.en: The fumes from the bus made me cough.
ex.ko: 버스 매연 때문에 나는 기침을 했다.

easy: Giving out something official, like new stamps or passports.

ex.en: The post office celebrated the issuance of a new stamp.
ex.ko: 우체국은 새 우표 발행을 기념했다.

easy: A group of army officers who take over a country by force and rule it.

ex.en: The junta closed the newspapers after it took power.
ex.ko: 군사 정권은 권력을 잡은 뒤 신문사들을 폐쇄했다.

easy: Printing false things about someone to hurt their good name.

ex.en: The actor sued the magazine for libel.
ex.ko: 그 배우는 명예 훼손으로 잡지사를 고소했다.

easy: To print false things about someone that hurt their good name.

ex.en: The newspaper was accused of libeling the mayor.
ex.ko: 그 신문은 시장의 명예를 훼손했다는 비난을 받았다.

easy: To push a person or group to the side so they feel left out and unimportant.

ex.en: We should not marginalize kids who are new to our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에 새로 온 아이들을 소외시켜서는 안 된다.

easy: Something that keeps causing you trouble or that you can never beat.

ex.en: Math word problems are my nemesis.
ex.ko: 수학 문장제는 나의 골칫거리이다.

easy: A songbird of Europe, Asia, and Africa; the male is often bright yellow and black.

ex.en: We heard an oriole singing in the tall trees.
ex.ko: 우리는 키 큰 나무에서 꾀꼬리가 노래하는 소리를 들었다.

easy: Having to do with the pancreas, a body part near the stomach that helps digest food.

ex.en: Pancreatic juices help break down the food you eat.
ex.ko: 췌장액은 먹은 음식을 분해하는 것을 돕는다.

easy: Arranged by chance, on purpose, with no pattern.

ex.en: The teacher used a randomized list to pick who reads first.
ex.ko: 선생님은 무작위로 만든 명단으로 누가 먼저 읽을지 정하셨다.

easy: Grand and fit for a king or queen.

ex.en: The lion walked across the rocks with a regal look.
ex.ko: 사자는 위엄 있는 모습으로 바위 위를 걸었다.

easy: Einstein's big idea that space and time can change depending on how fast you move.

ex.en: Albert Einstein came up with the theory of relativity.
ex.ko: 알베르트 아인슈타인은 상대성 이론을 생각해 냈다.

easy: A small kind of sea turtle.

ex.en: Kemp's ridley turtles lay their eggs on beaches in Texas.
ex.ko: 켐프 리들리바다거북은 텍사스 해변에 알을 낳는다.

easy: A member of a people in the far north of Europe who are known for herding reindeer.

ex.en: The Sami herd reindeer in the snowy north of Norway.
ex.ko: 사미족은 노르웨이 북쪽 눈 덮인 땅에서 순록을 기른다.

easy: Very bad and wrong, especially against religious rules.

ex.en: In the story, the sinful king was punished for his cruelty.
ex.ko: 이야기 속 사악한 왕은 잔인한 짓을 해서 벌을 받았다.

easy: Having to do with both money and a person's place in society.

ex.en: Kids from every socioeconomic background go to our school.
ex.ko: 우리 학교에는 다양한 사회 경제적 배경의 아이들이 다닌다.

easy: The US government agency that checks people and bags at airports to keep travel safe.

ex.en: The TSA checked our bags at the airport.
ex.ko: 공항에서 교통 보안청 직원이 우리 가방을 검사했다.

easy: A jet plane that carries passengers on short trips.

ex.en: We flew to Boston on a small airbus.
ex.ko: 우리는 작은 여객기를 타고 보스턴에 갔다.

easy: To swell up and get puffy, often with gas or water.

ex.en: My tummy bloated after I drank three sodas.
ex.ko: 탄산음료를 세 개나 마셨더니 배가 빵빵하게 부풀었다.

easy: A small, fast warship used to protect other ships.

ex.en: The corvette guarded the cargo ships on their way.
ex.ko: 코르벳함이 가는 길 내내 화물선들을 지켰다.

easy: Making people not want to do something.

ex.en: The tall fence had a deterrent effect on the deer.
ex.ko: 높은 울타리 덕분에 사슴이 들어오지 못했다.

easy: Something that gets in the way or slows things down.

ex.en: Rain was a big deterrent to our picnic plans.
ex.ko: 비 때문에 우리 소풍 계획이 크게 틀어졌다.
